paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of difficulty levels, comprising five slices. The segments include "Medium" in pink, which constitutes 51.8% of the chart, "Hard" in blue at 25.7%, "Easy" in green at 11.2%, "Very hard" in orange at 6.5%, and "Very easy" in purple at 4.7%. The chart features a legend on the top left with corresponding colors and category details, and each slice has its percentage labeled inside. The slices are ordered by descending size, visually emphasizing the proportion of each difficulty level. None of the slices are explosively offset or given bold emphasis.
